latestVersion.changelog:
Initial release of capability-evolver: a meta-skill for self-improving AI agents through protocol-driven evolution.

- Enables agents to analyze runtime history, identify failures, and autonomously evolve code or memory.
- Supports configurable evolution strategies, rollback modes, and integration with remote memory/knowledge graph services.
- Uses environment variables for flexible setup and operation, including security and networking options.
- Offers both automated and human-in-the-loop (review) operation modes.
- Integrates with OpenClaw and EvoMap for distributed self-evolution and asset publishing.
